tools.name: add_agent_guidance_entry
tools.description: Add or update a first-class agent guidance entry that points at an existing Den document.

document_project_id.description: Project ID where the referenced document lives. Defaults to project_id.

document_slug.description: Document slug to include in resolved guidance.

importance.description: Importance: required or important. Default: important.

notes.description: Optional notes for why this document is included.

project_id.description: Guidance scope project or space ID. Use '_global' for guidance inherited by all projects and spaces.

sort_order.description: Deterministic sort order within the scope. Lower comes first. Default: 0.

tools.name: add_dependency
tools.description: Add a dependency between tasks. Rejects if it would create a cycle.

tools.name: archive_document_preflight
tools.description: Check whether a document can be safely archived. Returns active references (agent guidance entries) that would be affected. Prefer running this before update_document_visibility to archived.

tools.name: archive_space
tools.description: Convenience method to archive a space (set visibility to 'archived'). Preserves all data but removes space from default listing. Reversible via update_space_visibility.

tools.name: await_github_checks
tools.description: Compatibility alias for watch_github_checks. This operation returns immediately and does not await terminal checks.

agent_instance_id.description: Optional runtime instance ID for correlation.

agent_profile.description: Optional logical agent profile for correlation.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA to watch. Den tracks this exact SHA, not latest branch head.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Optional poll interval in seconds for this gate. Defaults to review service config.

ref.description: Branch or ref the agent pushed, e.g. main.

requested_by.description: Agent or user registering the gate.

required_checks.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of required GitHub check run names.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Defaults to review service config.

tools.name: comment_on_document
tools.description: Add ONE comment to a Den document identified by project_id + slug. This is the green path when the user says "comment on this document." You do NOT need to call get_document_discussion or list_discussion_threads first; Core auto-creates a default discussion thread and writes the comment to it. Use parent_comment_id only when replying to a specific existing comment. Use anchor only when the comment targets a specific section/location. Use create_discussion_comment only when the user explicitly provides a discussion thread ID.

author_identity.description: Author identity string (e.g. agent name or username).

comment_kind.description: Comment kind: comment, question, answer, resolution, version_note. Default: comment.

mentions.description: JSON array of mentioned identities. Accepts native JSON or JSON-encoded string.

parent_comment_id.description: Parent comment ID for replies. Omit for root-level comments.

source_refs.description: JSON array of source references. Accepts native JSON or JSON-encoded string.

tools.name: create_board_comment
tools.description: Reply to a Board post or directly to one comment. parent_comment_id identifies the immediate parent; omit it to comment on the original post.

author_identity.description: Human or agent identity shown as the author.

parent_comment_id.description: Immediate parent comment ID; omit for a direct reply to the post.

tools.name: create_board_post
tools.description: Create a titled Board post. Board is durable passive conversation, not an executable task, wake, or instruction lane.

author_identity.description: Human or agent identity shown as the author.

project_id.description: Project whose Board should be accessed.

tools.name: create_discussion_comment
tools.description: Low-level thread-ID comment tool for adding a comment to an existing discussion thread by ID. Prefer comment_on_document for normal document comments — it auto-creates the thread. Use parent_comment_id to reply to an existing comment.

author_identity.description: Author identity string (e.g. agent name or username).

comment_kind.description: Comment kind: comment, question, answer, resolution, version_note. Default: comment.

mentions.description: JSON array of mentioned identities. Accepts native JSON or JSON-encoded string.

parent_comment_id.description: Parent comment ID for replies. Omit for root-level comments.

source_refs.description: JSON array of source references. Accepts native JSON or JSON-encoded string.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Register a new project for task management, messaging, and document storage.

id.description: Unique project ID slug, e.g. 'my-project'. Typically the directory name.

root_path.description: Absolute path to the project root on disk.

tools.name: create_review_finding
tools.description: Create a structured finding for a review round.

created_by.description: Agent or reviewer creating the finding.

file_references.description: Optional JSON array of file refs such as ["src/Foo.cs:42"].

run_id.description: Optional sub-agent run ID for audit traceability.

subagent_role.description: Optional sub-agent role for identity validation (e.g. 'reviewer'). When provided, created_by must follow the '<agent>-<role>' convention.

test_commands.description: Optional JSON array of test commands relevant to the finding.

tools.name: create_review_round
tools.description: Create or idempotently reuse a review request for the current checkout and task context. The reviewer reads the current repository state when the request is handled.

base_branch.description: Base branch for the intended diff, e.g. main or task/543-parent.

branch.description: Head branch under review, e.g. task/544-fix-review-loop.

notes.description: Optional scope notes or rereview notes.

tests_run.description: Optional JSON array of test commands run by the implementer.

tools.name: create_space
tools.description: Create a new space. Can be any kind (project, personal, assistant, knowledge_base, system).

kind.description: Space kind: project, personal, assistant, knowledge_base, system. Defaults to project.

root_path.description: Absolute path to the project root on disk (meaningful mainly for project kind).

visibility.description: Visibility: normal, hidden, archived. Defaults to normal.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task or subtask in a project.

assigned_to.description: Agent identity to assign this task to.

depends_on.description: Comma-separated task IDs this task depends on.

parent_id.description: Parent task ID to create this as a subtask.

tags.description: JSON array of string tags, e.g. ["core","api"]. Accepts a native JSON array or a JSON-encoded string for backward compatibility.

tools.name: delete_agent_guidance_entry
tools.description: Delete a first-class agent guidance entry by project or space scope and ID.

project_id.description: Guidance scope project or space ID that owns the entry. Use '_global' for global guidance entries.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document by project or space ID and slug.

tools.name: den_knowledge_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one Knowledge entry by exact slug, including its revision history, tags, and links. This is irreversible and should be used only for deliberate curation of obsolete, duplicate, or low-value records; do not archive entries selected for removal.

slug.description: Exact Knowledge entry slug to hard delete.

tools.name: den_knowledge_get
tools.description: Get a full knowledge entry by slug, including body_markdown. Use this after den_knowledge_search or den_knowledge_guide to read full content. Returns 404-style error if slug not found.

tools.name: den_knowledge_guide
tools.description: Guided retrieval: given a natural-language question or confusion, returns a compact answer card with cited excerpts from the knowledge library. No LLM calls — every claim is backed by a citation excerpt. Reports gaps/uncertainty when the library lacks reliable coverage. Use this when you want an answer synthesized across multiple knowledge entries, rather than raw search results.

tools.name: den_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search the global knowledge library by FTS query with tag gating. Returns only reviewed entries by default; use include_unreviewed/include_deprecated to override. Results include snippets but not full body_markdown — use den_knowledge_get for full content. This is the green path when an agent needs to look up reference material, conventions, gotchas, or architecture notes. You do NOT need to call this before den_knowledge_guide — that tool handles its own search.

tools.name: den_knowledge_store
tools.description: Create or update a knowledge entry. Only planner and runner profiles can upsert knowledge. Global scope — no project_id required. Use curation_state='agent_curated' with status='reviewed' for verified content, or 'unreviewed_import' with status='draft' for imported candidates awaiting review. Tags are managed as a separate table — pass the full tag set on each upsert (replace semantics). Revisions are automatically created on updates.

change_note.description: Optional change note for revision history.

curation_state.description: Curation state: unreviewed_import, human_curated, agent_curated, needs_recheck.

kind.description: Kind: concept, reference, glossary, convention, service_map, tool_notes, gotcha, architecture_note, migration_note.

status.description: Status: draft, reviewed, needs_review, deprecated, archived.

tools.name: discover_github_checks
tools.description: Read GitHub check runs for an exact commit and optionally validate exact required names without creating a gate, changing a task, or posting evidence.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA to inspect. Discovery is exact-SHA and read-only.

required_checks.description: Optional JSON array or comma-separated list of exact GitHub check-run names to validate against observed runs.

tools.name: ensure_document_discussion
tools.description: Ensure a document has a default discussion thread and return it. Use get_document_discussion for read-only lookup.

tools.name: finalize_review
tools.description: Finalize a normal review exactly once. This durable saga posts the canonical findings packet and transitions the task; retries resume incomplete delivery checkpoints. Supports looks_good and changes_requested only.

decided_by.description: Agent or user making the review decision and task transition.

new_findings.description: Optional JSON array of structured current-round findings; each has category, summary, notes, file_references, and test_commands.

notes.description: Optional final review notes included in the canonical packet.

prior_finding_resolutions.description: Optional JSON array of {finding_id, status, verification_note} terminal prior-finding resolutions.

thread_id.description: Optional existing task-thread root for the canonical packet.

tools.name: get_agent_guidance
tools.description: Resolve the Den-native agent guidance packet for a project or space, combining _global and space-scoped guidance entries in deterministic order.

project_id.description: Project or space ID to resolve guidance for.

tools.name: get_board_comment
tools.description: Get one visible Board comment without expanding descendants.

tools.name: get_board_comment_path
tools.description: Get a bounded breadcrumb path from the original post to one visible comment. Content-purged intermediate ancestors may appear only as structural tombstones.

tools.name: get_board_post
tools.description: Get one visible Board post without dumping its comments. Traverse replies separately with list_board_comments.

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Intentionally expand one concise read result using its opaque detail_ref. Detail reads are allowlisted, read-only, and preserve the original backend authorization path.

detail_ref.description: Opaque detail reference returned by a concise read tool.

tools.name: get_discussion_thread
tools.description: Get a single discussion thread by ID, optionally including its comments. Returns thread metadata and, when include_comments=true, all comments in chronological order.

include_comments.description: If true, include full comment list.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get a document's full content by project or space ID and slug. Returns documents regardless of visibility (normal, hidden, archived). Concise by default with content preview.

tools.name: get_document_discussion
tools.description: Read discussion threads and comments for a document without creating state. Use ensure_document_discussion only when a default thread must exist.

anchor.description: Optional anchor to filter threads by.

include_resolved.description: If true, include resolved and archived threads in results.

tools.name: get_github_check_gate
tools.description: Read an existing exact-SHA GitHub check gate without changing its timeout or polling state.

commit_sha.description: Exact 40-character commit SHA of the existing gate.

task_id.description: Task ID that owns the existing gate.

tools.name: get_handoff
tools.description: Retrieve the complete current Markdown handoff and server-owned revision/timestamp metadata for an exact label. Reading a handoff never wakes an agent or executes work.

label.description: Exact case-sensitive handoff label, such as den-services, task/6651, or campaign:gateway-cutover.

tools.name: get_latest_task_packet
tools.description: Get the latest task-thread packet by packet metadata type/role. Returns the exact message reference for worker launch.

packet_type.description: Optional packet type, e.g. coder_context_packet or reviewer_context_packet.

role.description: Optional packet role, e.g. coder or reviewer.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Get messages in a project, with optional filters. Returns newest first. Concise by default with content previews. For waiting on unread work, use wait_for_messages instead; do not tight-loop get_messages after an empty unread result.

limit.description: Max messages to return. Default 20, max 100.

since.description: ISO datetime — only messages after this time.

task_id.description: Filter to messages on a specific task.

unread_for.description: Agent identity — only unread messages for this agent.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a project by ID with summary stats (task counts by status, unread messages).

agent.description: Your agent identity, for unread message count.

tools.name: get_review_context
tools.description: Compose a bounded, read-only current review startup context from the canonical task, current review round, gate, packet headers, and guidance handles. It fails closed when no current review round exists and never falls back to the broad task context.

task_id.description: Canonical task ID whose current review context should be composed.

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Get a space by ID with summary stats (task counts by status, unread messages).

agent.description: Your agent identity, for unread message count.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get full task details including dependencies, subtasks, and recent messages. Concise by default with bounded recent messages and descriptions.

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Compose a bounded, read-only Den task briefing from canonical task, workflow, guidance, librarian, and task-thread authorities. The canonical task supplies project scope. A missing canonical task is an error; degraded optional sources are labelled in source_status.

tools.name: get_task_workflow_summary
tools.description: Get a compact task workflow summary for orchestrator startup/drain. Returns task status, current review state, latest packet headers (without full bodies), unresolved findings/actions, and links/message IDs. Use get_task for full detail. .

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Get a complete message thread — the root message plus all replies in chronological order. Concise by default with content previews.

tools.name: get_user_notifications
tools.description: Get the canonical user notification feed. Returns notifications across projects, newest first, with optional filters for project, task, sender, metadata type, urgency, and read state. Each notification includes id, project_id, task_id, sender, content, metadata, urgency, is_read, and created_at. Concise by default with content previews.

is_read.description: Filter by read state. Must provide read_for_agent when set.

project_id.description: Filter to a specific project/space ID. Omit for cross-project listing.

read_for_agent.description: Agent identity for read-state derivation. Required when is_read is set.

task_id.description: Filter to a specific task ID.

urgency.description: Filter by urgency: low, normal, or high.

tools.name: list_agent_guidance_entries
tools.description: List first-class agent guidance entries for a project or space. Use include_global to also show inherited _global entries.

include_global.description: Whether to include _global entries inherited by the project.

project_id.description: Project or space ID whose entries should be listed.

tools.name: list_board_comments
tools.description: List one bounded page of direct visible children under a post or parent comment. Omit parent_comment_id for comments directly on the original post; repeat per child to walk the tree.

after_id.description: Optional exclusive cursor ID for the next bounded page.

parent_comment_id.description: Immediate parent comment ID; omit for the post root.

tools.name: list_board_posts
tools.description: List one bounded page of visible Board post summaries. This never expands comment trees.

after_id.description: Optional exclusive cursor ID for the next bounded page.

project_id.description: Project whose Board should be accessed.

tools.name: list_discussion_threads
tools.description: List discussion threads across targets. Currently supports document-target threads only; omit target_type or set target_type=document. Filter by target_project_id, target_slug, or status. Default limit is 50.

status.description: Filter by thread status: open, resolved, archived.

target_project_id.description: Project or space ID to filter by.

target_type.description: Target type filter. Currently only 'document' is supported. Omit to search all document threads.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List document summaries (without content). Excludes archived documents by default. Omit project_id to list across all projects and spaces. Concise by default.

doc_type.description: Filter by type: prd, spec, adr, convention, reference, note, memory.

project_id.description: Project or space ID. Omit to list across all projects and spaces.

tags.description: Filter by tags (comma-separated). Document must have ALL specified tags.

visibility.description: Filter by visibility: normal, hidden, archived. Omit to exclude archived documents.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List registered projects. Defaults to normal project-kind spaces only, excluding hidden or archived spaces.

tools.name: list_review_findings
tools.description: List review findings for a task or a specific review round. Concise by default.

resolved.description: Optional resolved filter. True = resolved/history, false = unresolved only.

status.description: Optional statuses (comma-separated): open, claimed_fixed, verified_fixed, not_fixed, superseded, split_to_follow_up.

tools.name: list_review_pipeline
tools.description: List a bounded read-only project review pipeline projection, including reviewable tasks with no round or gate. This does not create reviews, register gates, wake reviewers, finalize reviews, or change task state.

limit.description: Optional page size from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Optional non-negative page offset. Defaults to 0.

project_id.description: Project ID whose reviewable tasks should be listed.

tools.name: list_review_rounds
tools.description: List review rounds for a task in chronological order. Concise by default.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List spaces with optional kind and visibility filters.

kind.description: Filter by space kind (project, personal, assistant, knowledge_base, system). Omit to include all kinds.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a project with optional filters. Returns summaries without descriptions. Concise by default.

parent_id.description: Filter by parent task ID to list subtasks. Omit for top-level tasks.

priority.description: Filter: tasks at this priority or higher (lower number = higher priority).

tags.description: Filter by tags (comma-separated). Task must have ALL specified tags.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark explicit user notification IDs as read for an agent identity. For scoped operations, use mark_project_notifications_read or mark_task_notifications_read.

agent.description: Agent identity to mark read for.

notification_ids.description: Comma-separated notification IDs to mark as read.

tools.name: mark_project_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all notifications in one project as read for an agent identity.

agent.description: Agent identity to mark read for.

project_id.description: Project whose notifications should be marked read.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark messages as read for an agent.

message_ids.description: Comma-separated message IDs to mark as read.

tools.name: mark_task_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all notifications on one canonical task as read for an agent identity. Project scope is derived from the task.

agent.description: Agent identity to mark read for.

task_id.description: Canonical task whose notifications should be marked read.

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: Get the next unblocked task to work on. Checks subtasks of in-progress parents first, then top-level planned tasks. Ranks by priority, then fewer dependencies, then lower ID. Concise by default.

assigned_to.description: Optionally filter to tasks assigned to this agent.

tools.name: post_review_findings
tools.description: Post a standardized reviewer findings packet for a review round back to the task thread.

notes.description: Optional summary note to append to the packet.

run_id.description: Optional sub-agent run ID for audit traceability.

sender.description: Agent or user posting the findings packet.

subagent_role.description: Optional sub-agent role for identity validation (e.g. 'reviewer'). When provided, sender must follow the '<agent>-<role>' convention.

thread_id.description: Optional task-thread message to reply to.

tools.name: purge_board_comment
tools.description: Purge one Board comment's authored content and identity from every normal surface. Retained descendants remain reachable through a content-free structural tombstone.

reason.description: Moderation reason retained without copying purged content.

tools.name: purge_board_post
tools.description: Purge a Board post and its entire reply subtree from every normal read, list, search, CLI, UI, and MCP surface. This destructive moderation action scrubs authored content and identity metadata.

reason.description: Moderation reason retained without copying purged content.

tools.name: query_archived_documents
tools.description: Deliberate archived document recall path. List or search documents that have been archived. Separate from default list_documents to prevent accidental inclusion of archived content.

doc_type.description: Filter by type: prd, spec, adr, convention, reference, note, memory.

project_id.description: Scope to one project or space.

query.description: Optional full-text search query. Omit to list all archived documents.

tools.name: query_librarian
tools.description: Ask the librarian for context relevant to your current work. Returns relevant tasks, documents, and messages with source attribution and recommendations. Best used at the start of a task or when you need background on a topic. Works with any space ID (project, personal, assistant, knowledge_base, etc.).

include_global.description: Whether to also search _global project documents. Default: true.

project_id.description: Project or space ID to search within.

query.description: What you're working on or looking for, e.g. 'I'm starting work on task 47 — implementing document search'.

task_id.description: Task ID to enrich search with task context (dependencies, messages, tags).

tools.name: record_human_acceptance_review
tools.description: Record a trusted human's affirmative task acceptance without creating or satisfying an agent review round or GitHub gate. The Tasks authority stores an immutable supplied-fact note, applies only the explicit lifecycle effect, and returns authoritative task/parent readback.

evidence_links.description: Optional JSON array or comma-separated evidence links supplied by the human.

expected_task_updated_at.description: Optional RFC3339 task updated_at readback used to reject stale confirmation.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated retry key scoped to this task and acceptance facts.

lifecycle_effect.description: Explicit effect: record_only, complete_task, or complete_task_and_parent. Defaults to record_only; parent completion is never implicit.

rationale.description: Short hands-on observation or rationale. Omit for the plain Looks good easy path.

reviewed_revision.description: Optional exact revision or version actually reviewed.

reviewer_identity.description: Authenticated or trusted-caller-reconciled human reviewer identity.

task_id.description: Canonical task receiving the human acceptance record.

verdict.description: Affirmative verdict. Omit for looks_good; no other verdict is accepted.

tools.name: remove_dependency
tools.description: Remove a dependency between tasks.

tools.name: render_worker_prompt
tools.description: Render a small worker startup prompt that points at a Den packet message reference without embedding the packet body in process args.

completion_reporting_mode.description: Completion reporting mode: worker_mcp_tool or artifact_reconciled. Default worker_mcp_tool.

tools.name: request_campaign_review
tools.description: Request a campaign reconciliation review from approved child review rounds and the current named repositories. Children must be direct subtasks or share the campaign:<parent_project_id>:<parent_task_id> tag.

children.description: JSON array of {project_id, task_id, review_round_id} child snapshots.

repositories.description: JSON array of {repository} entries naming the repositories in the campaign.

requested_by.description: Agent or user requesting campaign reconciliation.

tests_run.description: Optional JSON array or comma-separated list of campaign verification commands.

thread_id.description: Optional task thread receiving the review packet.

tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Create or idempotently reuse a review request for the current checkout and task context. The reviewer reads the current repository state when the request is handled.

base_branch.description: Base branch for the intended diff, e.g. main or task/596-parent.

branch.description: Head branch under review, e.g. task/597-review-packet-ux.

notes.description: Optional scope notes or rereview notes.

run_id.description: Optional sub-agent run ID for audit traceability.

tests_run.description: Optional JSON array of test commands run by the implementer.

thread_id.description: Optional task-thread message to reply to.

tools.name: respond_to_review_finding
tools.description: Add implementer response notes to a review finding and optionally mark it claimed_fixed or otherwise update status. response_notes record the implementer response; status_notes record evidence for the status transition. Use follow_up_task_id only with split_to_follow_up.

follow_up_task_id.description: Optional follow-up task ID. Required for split_to_follow_up and rejected for all other statuses.

responded_by.description: Agent or user responding to the finding.

response_notes.description: Optional implementer response notes; stored separately from reviewer/status verification notes.

run_id.description: Optional sub-agent run ID for audit traceability.

status.description: Optional status update: open, claimed_fixed, verified_fixed, not_fixed, superseded, split_to_follow_up.

status_notes.description: Optional notes explaining this status transition; use for current verification/status evidence.

subagent_role.description: Optional sub-agent role for identity validation (e.g. 'reviewer'). When provided, responded_by must follow the '<agent>-<role>' convention.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Full-text search across documents. Excludes archived documents. Supports AND, OR, NOT, and "phrase" queries. Concise by default with snippets.

project_id.description: Scope search to one project or space.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message in a project. Can be project-level, attached to a task, or a reply in a thread.

intent.description: Optional canonical intent, e.g. review_feedback or handoff.

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata object or JSON-encoded string, e.g. {"type":"review_request"}.

sender.description: Your agent identity, e.g. 'pi' or another manual agent identity.

task_id.description: Attach to a task by ID.

thread_id.description: Reply to an existing message (forms a thread).

tools.name: send_user_notification
tools.description: Send a user-facing notification message in a project. Use this when you have noteworthy information for the user that should not require stopping the run or waiting for a final response. Examples: server needs redeployment, a long-running task completed, a blocking issue needs user decision. Notifications appear prominently in the Den Desktop Messages tab.Prefer this over send_message when the message is specifically for the user rather than general task tracking.

content.description: Notification body (markdown). Keep it concise and actionable.

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata object or JSON-encoded string.

sender.description: Your agent identity, e.g. 'pi' or another manual agent identity.

task_id.description: Attach to a task by ID.

urgency.description: Optional urgency hint: low, normal, or high. Defaults to normal.

tools.name: set_handoff
tools.description: Create or silently replace the one current non-executable Markdown handoff for an exact arbitrary label. The service records UTC timestamps and returns the resulting revision; caller Markdown is never rewritten.

body_markdown.description: Complete Markdown resume note. Maximum 64 KiB; frontmatter, if present, remains caller-owned and unchanged.

label.description: Exact case-sensitive handoff label, such as den-services, task/6651, or campaign:gateway-cutover.

tools.name: set_review_finding_status
tools.description: Update the status for a review finding. Notes are status/verification evidence and do not replace implementer response_notes. Use follow_up_task_id only with split_to_follow_up; non-split status transitions clear any old follow-up link.

follow_up_task_id.description: Optional follow-up task ID. Required for split_to_follow_up and rejected for all other statuses.

notes.description: Optional status/verification notes for this transition.

run_id.description: Optional sub-agent run ID for audit traceability.

status.description: New status: open, claimed_fixed, verified_fixed, not_fixed, superseded, split_to_follow_up.

subagent_role.description: Optional sub-agent role for identity validation (e.g. 'reviewer'). When provided, updated_by must follow the '<agent>-<role>' convention.

updated_by.description: Agent or user updating the finding status.

tools.name: split_review_findings_to_follow_up
tools.description: Split selected non-blocking review findings into a follow-up task. Creates a follow-up task with generated description and marks each finding split_to_follow_up. Blocking findings are skipped unless override_blocking=true.

finding_ids.description: JSON array of review finding IDs to split.

follow_up_assigned_to.description: Optional agent identity to assign the follow-up task to.

follow_up_parent_task_id.description: Optional parent task ID for the follow-up task.

follow_up_priority.description: Priority for the follow-up task (1-5). Default: 3.

follow_up_tags.description: Optional JSON array of string tags for the follow-up task. Accepts a native JSON array or a JSON-encoded string for backward compatibility.

follow_up_title.description: Optional title for the follow-up task. Default: auto-generated.

override_blocking.description: If true, include blocking findings in the split. Default: false.

split_by.description: Agent or user performing the split.

task_id.description: Task ID that owns the review findings.

tools.name: store_document
tools.description: Create or update a document. The full markdown content is persisted; the MCP result returns bounded metadata, byte count, SHA-256, and a preview so large writes are not mistaken for clipped storage.

doc_type.description: Document type: prd, spec, adr, convention, reference, note, memory. Default: spec.

project_id.description: Project or space ID. Use '_global' for cross-project docs.

slug.description: Unique slug within the project, e.g. 'damage-system-spec'.

summary.description: Optional short summary for indexing and listing.

tags.description: JSON array of string tags. Accepts a native JSON array or a JSON-encoded string for backward compatibility.

tools.name: update_discussion_thread
tools.description: Update a discussion thread's status, summary, resolution_summary, or title. Common use: mark threads as resolved or archived after discussion concludes.

resolution_summary.description: Optional resolution summary. Typically set when status=resolved.

status.description: New status: open, resolved, archived. Omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: update_document_visibility
tools.description: Update a document's visibility to normal, hidden, or archived. Archiving is a status flip — not data movement. Use archive_document_preflight first to check for active references.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update mutable metadata fields for an existing project. Only fields explicitly provided (non-null) are changed; all other fields are left as-is. Safe — will not overwrite existing data with blanks.

root_path.description: New absolute root path on disk (optional). Set to empty string to clear.

tools.name: update_space_visibility
tools.description: Update a space's visibility (normal, hidden, archived). The preferred green path for removing spaces from normal lists without data loss. Archived spaces are preserved but excluded from default list views.

visibility.description: New visibility value: normal, hidden, archived.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a task's fields. Records changes in audit history. When setting status to 'blocked', blocker_summary and blocker_reason are required.

agent.description: Your agent identity (required for audit trail).

blocker_attempted_remedies.description: Optional when status=blocked. Remedies or evidence of what was attempted.

blocker_reason.description: Required when status=blocked. Why the agent cannot proceed.

blocker_requires_human_input.description: Optional when status=blocked. Whether human input is required vs planner can replan. Default: false.

blocker_suggested_next_step.description: Optional when status=blocked. Suggested next decision or unblock path.

blocker_summary.description: Required when status=blocked. Short blocker summary.

status.description: New status: planned, in_progress, review, blocked, done, cancelled.

tags.description: JSON array of string tags. Accepts a native JSON array or a JSON-encoded string for backward compatibility.

tools.name: wait_for_github_checks
tools.description: Wait briefly for an existing exact-SHA gate terminal event. Returns terminal state or a typed progress/timeout receipt without re-registering the gate.

after_id.description: Last terminal-event cursor already handled. Defaults to 0.

commit_sha.description: Exact 40-character commit SHA of the existing gate.

task_id.description: Task ID that owns the existing gate.

wait_ms.description: Bounded server wait in milliseconds. Defaults to no wait and is capped at 50000.

tools.name: wait_for_messages
tools.description: Wait for new unread messages in a project with a bounded timeout. Use this instead of polling get_messages in a tight loop. Returns compact new message headers (ID, sender, content preview) or a timeout receipt. Timeout capped at 60 seconds, polls every 500ms. After an empty result (timeout), stop — there is no new work.

cursor.description: Cursor message ID — skip messages with ID ≤ this value (for deduplication across waits).

limit.description: Max messages to return. Default 20, max 100.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait time in milliseconds (500–60000, default 30000).

unread_for.description: Agent identity — only unread messages for this agent.

tools.name: watch_github_checks
tools.description: Register or read the durable exact-SHA GitHub check gate and return its deferral handle/current status immediately.

agent_instance_id.description: Optional runtime instance ID for correlation.

agent_profile.description: Optional logical agent profile for correlation.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA to watch. Den tracks this exact SHA, not latest branch head.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Optional poll interval in seconds for this gate. Defaults to review service config.

ref.description: Branch or ref the agent pushed, e.g. main.

requested_by.description: Agent or user registering the gate.

required_checks.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of required GitHub check run names.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Defaults to review service config.
